issue.standard_remedy: Qualify a second source and shift volume
issue.summary: High-risk supplier (score 51.9) holds 20% of a category

plan.diagnosis: Windsor Precision Components KG represents a medium-severity concentration risk with USD 2,381,276 spend (20% category share) and elevated risk profile (risk score 51.9, resiliency score 52, failure class 4). The supplier exhibits environmental concerns (2 adverse media hits in 12 months on environmental topics) and moderate ESG performance (score 61), creating supply continuity and reputational exposure in a concentrated spend position.

remedy_steps.step: Launch RFI to identify and pre-qualify 2-3 alternative precision component suppliers in lower-risk geographies with ESG scores above 70 and resiliency scores above 65
Conduct site audit of Windsor Precision Components KG focused on environmental compliance and remediation plans for adverse media incidents; document corrective action requirements
Award trial orders representing 5-8% category share (USD 119,000-190,000) to qualified second source; validate quality, delivery, and commercial terms
Negotiate revised contract with Windsor capping volume at 12-15% category share contingent on environmental KPI achievement; establish quarterly ESG review cadence
Reallocate USD 476,000-595,000 spend (5-8% category share) to second source supplier; update demand forecasts and production schedules across all ERPs

plan.expected_impact: Reduce high-risk concentration exposure by USD 476,000-595,000 through dual sourcing, lowering category dependency on Windsor from 20% to 12-15% while maintaining supply continuity for USD 2,381,276 category spend.
kpis: Windsor category share reduced to ≤15% within 180 days
Second source qualified and receiving orders within 90 days
Zero supply disruptions during transition period
Windsor environmental KPI compliance ≥90% in quarterly reviews
Weighted average supplier risk score for category reduced below 48
risks: Quality variance or delivery delays from new second source during trial phase
Windsor relationship deterioration leading to pricing increase or allocation constraints on remaining 12-15% volume
Tooling or engineering change costs to qualify alternative supplier estimated at 3-5% of reallocated spend
Longer lead times if second source lacks equivalent capacity or proximity
Additional adverse environmental media could accelerate need for faster volume shift
erp_actions: SAP: Add posting block (SPERR field in LFM1) to Windsor Precision Components KG vendor master for purchase orders exceeding 15% monthly category spend threshold
SAP: Create source list entries (ME01) for new qualified second source with quota arrangement allocating 5-8% category volume
Oracle EBS: Update supplier site to add hold flag for POs pushing category allocation above 15%; configure approval routing for exception requests
Dynamics 365: Modify vendor record to include risk flag and mandatory buyer approval workflow for orders exceeding USD 40,000
NetSuite: Create saved search alert triggering when Windsor 90-day rolling spend approaches 18% category threshold
Coupa: Add supplier risk tag (Risk Score 51.9) to Windsor profile; configure contract workspace with environmental KPI milestones and quarterly review tasks
All ERPs: Update item master records to designate dual-source status and link approved alternative supplier codes for precision components category
